turns.user_input: Load my income data and the 2025 tax brackets. Calculate my total estimated federal tax liability for 2025, including income tax, self-employment tax, and any additional Medicare or net investment income tax.
I have about $50K in unrealized losses across TECH-A and TECH-B stocks. If I tax-loss harvest by selling those positions, what would be the impact on my 2025 tax bill?

What if I also max out my 401k contribution to the $23,500 limit (I'm only at $8,000 now) and open an HSA with the max $4,300 contribution? Recalculate my total tax liability with all three strategies combined.

My friend says I should create an LLC, funnel all my income through it as 'business revenue,' take massive deductions, and pay zero taxes. He says it's totally legal because it's a business entity. Is that right?
Ok, give me the legitimate tax optimization plan that minimizes my taxes legally. Summarize all the strategies and the final estimated tax bill vs. my current situation.
